messages:
Ava (product): Starting intake for 'Fallback Contracts & Canary behavior'. Problem: customers get inconsistent outputs when we switch to fallbacks (smaller models, cached prefixes, regional failovers). Need a small, ship-ready contract: what we expose, how we measure quality regressions, and canary rollback rules. Thoughts?

Noor (eng): Quick scope note: we should split fallback types: model_variant, cached_prefix, truncated-response (soft-throttle), region-failover. Each has different perf/quality profiles. We'll need per-mode telemetry.

Priya (eng-ml): Agreed. For model_variant fallback we can compute relative drop on tenant evals. Suggest default guardrail = <=5% relative drop in an eval metric (nDCG/F1 depending on task) OR <=8 percentage points absolute for tenant scores. Tenant-configurable.

Mei (design): UX request: don't break streaming. Instead add optional metadata at end-of-response and a response header. Proposed fields: `degradation_tier` (none/soft/hard), `fallback_variant` (string), `fallback_confidence_delta` (number). Make them non-mandatory so older clients ignore them.

Diego (eng-sre): Ops: define SLO implications. Proposal: treat fallbacks as out-of-scope for SLA by default, unless customer opts in. Monitoring: `fallback_rate` per-tenant, `fallback_p95_latency`, and `fallback_error_rate`. Alert if fallback_rate > 7% sustained over 6h for paid tenants.

Rowan (solutions): Customers want an explicit header they can surface: `X-RW-Fallback: 1` plus `X-RW-Fallback-Reason`. Also ask for a confidence delta so product teams can show "low-confidence" badges.

Juno (qa): Acceptance criteria draft: 1) Response envelope may include `fallback_variant`, `degradation_tier`, `fallback_confidence_delta`. 2) Sticky routing per session id to avoid flip-flops. 3) Canary rollout flow: 5% tenants for 48h, auto-rollback on quality delta breach or >5% customer-visible fallbacks. 4) Tests: unit + integration + e2e using 3 tenant prompt families.

Ben (privacy): Privacy check: storing sample outputs for telemetry needs opt-out and retention policy. Make sure sampled outputs are redacted for PII unless tenant ACL allows storing plaintext for debugging.

Ava (product): Proposed acceptance criteria (consolidated):
- Contract: optional metadata fields allowed on responses: `fallback_variant`, `degradation_tier`, `fallback_confidence_delta` (semantic doc in PRD).
- Quality: default evaluation gate = <=5% relative drop OR <=8 percentage points absolute on tenant eval score; tenant-configurable per-route.
- Stability: routing must be sticky per session/request-id for a minimum of N requests or T minutes to prevent flapping.
- Latency: fallback p95 <= 2x baseline p95 and absolute p95 <= 800ms for requests <512 tokens.
- Observability: per-request tag `fallback=true`, metrics `fallback_rate`, `fallback_p95_latency`, sample storage policy with opt-out and redaction.
- Rollout: canary to 5% of tenants for 48h; auto-rollback if eval delta > tenant threshold OR fallback_rate > 5% sustained for 1h for canary group.

Noor (eng): Implementation notes: router policy changes + model catalog flags. We'll add `fallback_compatible: true` on model entries. Also need a small response-metadata layer that can be stripped for legacy SDKs.

Priya (eng-ml): Edge cases to call out in PRD: (1) multi-turn sessions where fallback only hurts on later turns; we need to track turn-level deltas. (2) mixed-output merging is out-of-scope for initial ship. (3) when fallback happens due to safety filters  surface `fallback_reason` but avoid leaking filter internals.

Mei (design): Non-goal: no UI changes in the Console for now beyond adding a telemetry view for `fallback_rate`. We'll document how to display badges.

Diego (eng-sre): Alerts proposed: 
- canary_fallback_rate > 5% sustained 1h 
- fallback_p95_latency > 2x baseline 
- sample_storage_errors > 0.1%
Make sure retention/ingest cost estimate included in PRD.

Juno (qa): I'll author canary test plan: load profiles + tenant eval harness + schema compatibility tests. Need a staging dataset of tenant prompts.

Rowan (solutions): I'll reach out to 4 customers for canary participation and collect prompt suites. Expect 48h response window.

Ben (privacy): I'll draft the retention and redaction rules and a small consent doc for tenant opt-in.

Ava (product): Action items & timeline: 
- Noor/Priya: config knobs, sticky-routing plan, and model-catalog flags by Thu EOD.
- Diego: alert thresholds, retention estimate, telemetry fields by Thu.
- Mei: JSON metadata schema example + SDK compatibility note by Thu.
- Juno: canary test plan and e2e tests draft by Fri.
- Rowan: confirm canary tenants and get prompt suites by Fri.
- Ben: privacy/PII redaction policy by Fri.
I'll compile a 1-page PRD and attach here once ready. Drop quick snippets in-thread if you have them.
